title: Execution points manifest
description: points.ep lists the application modules whose expressions tests can select. The TypeScript content mapper, the Vite plugin, and the `execution-points list` command all read it.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, so that an editor can check and complete the manifest.

tsconfig.description: The tsconfig.json that describes the target modules, relative to the manifest. Defaults to the tsconfig.json beside it.

targets.description: The target modules: paths and glob patterns, relative to the manifest.
